name: Demo External Tool Plugin
description: Pure-manifest plugin: wraps a command-line tool as an operator without shipping compiled code. demo:wordcount counts words/lines of a text file via the bundled script (python3).

operators.description: Counts lines/words/bytes of the 'input' text file using the bundled python script (external process, argv-only spawn).

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Path of the text file to inspect
